Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Portable LZ4 XOR codec acceptance

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
Shell
nix develop --command bash tests/replay_lz4/run.sh

The library implementation is pure Odin. Only this native oracle imports the reference LZ4 library; the dev shell supplies LZ4_LIB_DIR. Other environments need an installed LZ4 library or that variable pointing to its library directory.

768 cases cover six distributions, eight source alignments, lengths 0–65,535 and LZ4 length/end boundaries. Native default/optimized and executed WASM builds must agree on the encoded/mutation fingerprint. Round trips preserve every target byte. Short outputs, truncations, malformed mutations and disallowed aliases must retain transactional output on failure. The workspace cannot overlap either input/output.

The native LZ4 reference decoder reads our standard blocks as XOR bytes, and our codec reads reference-compressed XOR blocks. Selected mutated blocks accepted by our decoder must also decode to the same result in the reference implementation. No reference library is linked into production, Godot or the WASM corpus.
